# Peter McLinton

Peter McLinton is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 2014.

Peter McLinton has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2014 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/peter-mclinton#e20)

  Elected as Deputy of St Saviour No 1 with 52.6% of the ballot.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20230401082118/https://archive.vote.je/portfolio/mclinton-peter/)
  - [2014 SOS Jersey Q&A](http://sosjersey.co.uk/election-special-2014-what-they-said/)
  - [2014 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HA36F-Ifwlo)

Peter McLinton has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 3](https://flow.je/elections/district-3). \[[bailiwickexpress.com](https://www.bailiwickexpress.com/news/return-of-the-mac-and-a-former-constable/)\]

## Election History

### 2014 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Saviour No 1](https://flow.je/elections/st-saviour-no-1) (2 seats), 15th October 2014.

**Peter McLinton was elected as Deputy of St Saviour No 1 in 2014**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Jeremy Maçon](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/jeremy-macon)** |  | 780 | 62.6% |
| 2 | **Peter McLinton** |  | 656 | 52.6% |
| 3 | [Rob Duhamel](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/rob-duhamel) |  | 630 | 50.6% |

1,246 ballots (inc. 16 spoilt papers)

3,061 registered voters

= 40.7% turnout
